about_the_game:
The Ultimate Motorcycle Riding Simulation

TrackDayR is not just a racing game — it’s a riding experience. Every bike is built around real proportions, real behavior, and a physics system designed to reward precision, control, and progression. This is not arcade racing: it’s about learning, improving, and pushing your limits lap after lap.

Total Freedom on Two (and More) Wheels

Choose from a wide range of vehicles including pitbikes, dirt bikes, superbikes, ATVs, three-wheelers, sidecar MX, and prototype machines. Each vehicle delivers a unique riding style and requires a different approach to master. One game, countless ways to ride.

Train, Compete, and Race Online

Ride solo to refine your skills or jump online to race against other players. Compete in online sessions, compare lap times, and push your limits against riders from all over the world.

Global Rankings and Competitive Tournaments

TrackDayR features a global worldwide ranking system that tracks your performance across sessions and modes. Take part in organized tournaments to test your consistency, speed, and racecraft, and prove your value on an international competitive scale.

BikeJourney Mode – An Expanding Experience

BikeJourney is an experimental game mode that expands TrackDayR beyond traditional track sessions. Explore new ways to ride, progress, and interact with the game world through a mode designed to evolve over time alongside the community.

Built With and For the Community

TrackDayR is an evolving Early Access project shaped by player feedback. Frequent updates introduce new bikes, tracks, physics improvements, new competitive features, and additional game modes driven directly by the community.

Deep Modding Support – Powered by the Community

Modding is a core pillar of TrackDayR. Modders actively create bikes and tracks of every kind, experimenting with wildly different configurations, setups, and riding styles — from realistic replicas to unique, unconventional concepts. On our side, MadCow provides increasingly powerful and up-to-date modding tools, designed to give creators full control and freedom. Our goal is simple: give the community the space and the tools to push TrackDayR far beyond its default content.

Every Detail Matters

From tire behavior and weight transfer to riding lines and braking technique, every decision affects performance. TrackDayR rewards riders who learn, adapt, and refine their style.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Service Pack 1
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 770, Radeon HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 70 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB, Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
